rubric.role_summary: Remote U.S. personal-lines Property & Casualty insurance sales role serving inbound customers through quoting, comparing, binding, and servicing policies. Level II has additional experience and multi-carrier agency requirements.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Remote U.S. personal-lines Property & Casualty insurance sales role serving inbound customers through quoting, comparing, binding, and servicing policies. Level II has additional experience and multi-carrier agency requirements.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Minimum 1 year of experience as a P&C insurance agent; 3+ years for Level II.
- High school diploma or equivalent.
- Familiarity with personal-lines insurance carriers and their underwriting processes.
- Experience quoting, selling, and servicing personal-lines insurance products.
- Understanding of relevant insurance products and regulations.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- For Level I, an independent-agency or similar personal-lines background with demonstrated success quoting and binding across a multi-carrier marketplace.
- Previous experience in sales or customer service.
- For Level II, an independent-agency or similar personal-lines background with demonstrated success quoting and binding across a multi-carrier marketplace.
- Proficiency in CRM tools, email platforms, and quoting software.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): United States. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
